name: 70119 · New Orleans, LA
findings: ZIP 70119 (New Orleans) has 251 nonprofit organizations. 107 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 89 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70119 (New Orleans) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 70119 (New Orleans) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 89 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
